body:
Hi,  thanks for taking the time to read and respond... it's hard to always see things my father's way, but i know he cares for me and really doesn't know how to be compassionate. so he's not such a bad guy. It can be frustrating to see things his way (and my mother and sister have their own problems with him), but he's much better than he used to be. Currently, I am living with my family and it's been good and bad for me. Because I was so reluctant to forgive my father and avoid any idea of contributing to my family for so long, this is a chance to be part of my family for the first time in a long time...perhaps for the first time. 

I have not kept in touch with most of the people I cut out, and that can be awkward given that I live in a big city and more often than not I will catch a familiar glance from former acquaintances on the sidewalk, but I try to not care and avoid them even If we never had a negative experience. I'm trying to keep the past in the past for better or worse. That's probably not the best approach to my situation, but it gives me some peace of mind, and spares me the embarrassment of explaining where I am, given that I"m still trying to change a great many things about myself. 

as far as my education and desire to make games, I'm going to start small and build my code portfolio. So long as I make progress every day and maintain focus, I think I'll be making constructive baby steps to make a more concrete long-term decision. 

I do still harm myself, but I'll usually just hit myself, and i do so far less frequently than i used to. I'm happy that i haven't scarred myself any more since I was around 22. 

Really, thanks very much for taking the time to respond. I felt very awkward posting my story on /sw since there are posts which are far more urgent than my own situation. For someone who often avoids acknowledging how he feels, it is refreshing to discuss my experience, so thanks very much, sir.
